name: E. coli core metabolism (genome-scale, driven by dynamic FBA)
notes: Diversity-first stress component #2: a genome-scale metabolic network with NO rate laws, driven as a black box by dynamic FBA (cobra). (a) OPEN BOUNDARY -- biomass drains atoms out of the tracked medium; the exchange reactions ARE the declared boundary (TODO #3). (b) CANONICAL IDENTITY -- resolved the honest way AFTER the carbonate #4 finding: identity is a canonical ChEBI entity_id (which reconciles this box's pyruvate with a kinetic model's pyruvate), and the formula carries the species' ACTUAL atoms (pyruvate anion C3H3O3 = 3 H, not a neutralized 4 H). The earlier neutralization was RETIRED because it corrupted hydrogen counts. BiGG species ids are provenance (see port_map / the EX_ reaction ids), not identity. Charge is left untracked here (genome-scale charge balance is a separate concern); acid/base boxes like carbonate_system declare it.

validity.note: dynamic FBA: valid at quasi-steady-state (dt >> internal metabolic timescale, balanced growth). Fluxes are mmol/gDW/h-scale; unit reconciliation with concentration-based boxes is TODO #2.
